name: mysql-8.0-nested-union-all
query:
SELECT id FROM orders WHERE id < 3
UNION
SELECT c.id FROM customers c
JOIN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending' UNION ALL SELECT 1) d ON d.customer_id = c.id

        -> Nested loop inner join  (cost=28354 rows=19282)
            -> Table scan on d  (cost=21361..21605 rows=19282)
                -> Union all materialize  (cost=21361..21361 rows=19282)
                    -> Filter: (orders.`status` = 'pending')  (cost=19433 rows=19281)

            -> Filter: (d.customer_id = c.id)  (cost=0.25 rows=1)
                -> Single-row covering index lookup on c using PRIMARY (id=d.customer_id)  (cost=0.25 rows=1)
